truthBoundary: A62 can verify an exact official Node 24.18.0 archive for Windows x64 or Linux x64, its bundled npm 11.16.0, a complete lockfile-bound dependency tarball bundle, and an externally SHA-256-anchored Playwright Chromium bundle. It then prepares a no-network npm cache, proves a real browser launch, and invokes A60. It does not reconstruct missing artifacts, prove browser provenance beyond the supplied external anchor and launch test, prove staging or LIVE, or enable sale.
